name: openbb_yield_curve
description:
Meant to give the US Treasury yield curve for a date through OpenBB (obb.fixedincome.government.us_yield_curve).
Returns: {yield_curve: [...]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): date (YYYY-MM-DD; latest if omitted); provider (default federal_reserve).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.fixedincome.government.us_yield_curve (4.6 has fixedincome.government.yield_curve), so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: av_treasury_yield per maturity, or fred_2yr_treasury, fred_5yr_treasury, fred_10yr_treasury, fred_30yr_treasury and fred_yield_spread.
Example: {"date": "2026-09-30"}

date.description: Date for yield curve (YYYY-MM-DD, latest if omitted)
